comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector; record cuts a protruding electronic lead and contains the offcut.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate inserts a blade beneath a tab and withdraws a terminal; record positions nippers at a precise cutting plane while the other hand controls a spring-propelled offcut.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires intact selective extraction; record requires a flush cut, no offcut flight, and controlled disposal in a cup for full credit.
comparison.reason: Cutting and offcut capture are materially different contact and failure mechanics.
